items.title: Iran says it has given US 'concrete' seven-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran says it has given the US a "concrete" seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: British man and Greek wife 'killed in Athens gas leak explosion'
items.description: A British man and his Greek wife are believed to be among those killed in a building collapse caused by an explosion from a gas leak in Athens.

items.title: The most striking pictures of the week
OpenAI models accessed US government data and 'tried to hack another site'
items.description: OpenAI models accessed data on two US government websites and carried out an unsuccessful hack on a Department of Education site, according to new investigations.

items.title: Ireland confirms Nations League game against Israel will go ahead
items.description: The Football Association of Ireland (FAI) has confirmed the Nations League game against Israel on Sunday will go ahead after a player vote.

items.title: Bangkok declared disaster zone after more than 30cm of rain in 48 hours
items.description: Bangkok has been declared a disaster zone after parts of the Thai capital saw more than 30cm (12 inches) of rain in 48 hours, causing flooding across much of the city.

items.title: Robbie Williams sings with fans outside hotel after show cancelled in Peru
items.description: Robbie Williams was captured on video giving an impromptu performance outside his hotel in Peru after saying he was "broken-hearted" his concert was cancelled.

items.title: Gang jailed over plot to import cocaine and ketamine in frozen fish deliveries
items.description: A gang that plotted to import  cocaine and ketamine worth more than £20m into the UK hidden in frozen fish deliveries has been jailed for a total of more than 71 years.

items.title: Man shot during Trump assassination attempt dies
items.description: James Copenhaver, one of three people shot during an assassination attempt on Donald Trump at a campaign rally, has died.

items.title: At least 41 dead after boat capsizes in DR Congo
items.description: At least 41 people have died after a boat travelling from Tanzania to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) on Lake Tanganyika capsized, local authorities said.
